station#4463 slice 2 fix round (H2a), 52 -> 53. ProviderSettingsView.tsx's `listEmptyTitle="No model connections yet"` is new surface, not a reworded dodge: the list pane previously had no listEmptyTitle of its own (it fell through to SplitPaneLayout's generic default "No items yet"), and its search-matching detail-pane label derived the SAME claim from post-filter `items`, so a non-matching search falsely said "No model connections yet" while a connection existed off-screen (the review's H1/H2a finding). The fix wires `searchValue` (routing a filtered-to-nothing search to FilteredEmpty instead) and re-derives the detail label from the UNFILTERED collection; giving the list its own accurate, specific title is the other half of that same fix, not decoration. The count must otherwise only fall from here. AMENDMENT (delta review round 3, M2): the detail panel's OWN compact Empty — which used to render this same label unconditionally alongside the list — is now suppressed whenever the list already said something (genuinely empty OR filtered to nothing), so the list's listEmptyTitle is confirmed as the single owner of this string, not a lingering duplicate the ceiling was quietly paying for. Verified: the shipped count is unchanged at 53 after the dedupe (the string itself did not move), so the raise still buys exactly what it always bought — one accurate, non-duplicated title.

#3318 project-batch. 53 -> 54 for src-ui/src/workspace-panes/ProjectWorkspacePaneCatalog.tsx:100, description="No panes are active in this Project yet." on the active-panes Empty. This is the gate's "deliberate, reasoned addition" branch, not the silent-regrowth branch the previous note (#3208) fixed by rephrasing: that raise would have converted someone else's regression into policy, whereas this string is new surface #3318 introduced. The copy is load-bearing because #3318 SPLIT this section into two states that render from two different branches of ActivePaneContents — entries.length === 0 (nothing known/discovered, delegated to CatalogContents' own empty state) and activeEntries.length === 0 (panes exist and are available, but none is placed in THIS project). The label is already the shared-shaped "Nothing here yet"; the description is the only thing that distinguishes those two states, and their next actions differ (add a pane here vs install one at all). Collapsing it to the shared default would make the two branches render identically and lose the active-vs-known distinction the whole issue was about. Not reworded to dodge the pattern — the pattern is matching real, intended copy. The count must otherwise only fall.

UX-audit lane C2 (SHELL-09 / SHELL-13) added three checks, all recorded at 0 because the tree was brought to 0 in the same change, not because 0 was convenient: loadingStringCeiling (bespoke JSX loading text — the eleven treatments collapsed onto SkeletonList/SkeletonBlock), fabricatedLoadingCeiling (`const isLoading = false`, the literal mechanism of SHELL-09 in SkillsView and ConversationStats), and unguardedEmptyCeiling (files that render <Empty>, read a loading signal, and render no loading treatment — the general form). The last is a blunt FILE-level heuristic by construction (whether a given <Empty> sits inside the guard is not statically decidable); a file that trips it is a signal to sharpen the heuristic or fix the view, never to raise the number.

UX-audit lane C2, ROUND 2 (independent review M1 — "make the ratchet honest"). Three changes, all of them tightenings; no ceiling was raised.
1. adHocNoXCeiling 54 -> 52. Check 2 now skips test files, as checks 3-7 already did. A fixture string asserting that some OTHER component does not render its empty copy is not shipped copy, and counting it let test fixtures eat the shipped ceiling's headroom — the exact reading ("it only went up by one, and it was only a test") a real regression would hide behind. 52 is the shipped count on this tree.
2. loadingStringCeiling stays 0 under a MUCH wider scan. The review showed the old check was gameable twice over: it read literal JSX text beginning with "Loading" and nothing else, so both a hoisted `const WAIT = 'Loading notifications…'` and a plain "Fetching notifications…" passed. The vocabulary is now Loading|Fetching|Opening|Checking|Negotiating|Please wait across two channels (JSX text node, and any ellipsis-terminated wait sentence written as a string literal anywhere in the module), with comments blanked before scanning and pending-label ternaries (`{isPending ? 'Checking…' : submitLabel}` — the shared Button's own contract) excluded by derivation rather than by name. The three real offenders it found were FIXED, not baselined: LocalUiSessionGate's "Opening the sample workspace…", CredentialProfileEnrolment's "Checking sign-in state…", and SharedAnswerView's "Opening the shared answer…". One exclusion is named in PRE_SHELL_LOADING_EXCLUSIONS by file AND exact text — the pre-auth gate's "Checking this browser's Station access…", the one wait with no shell to keep and no region to skeleton — and a stale entry fails the gate, so it cannot quietly become a free slot.
3. unguardedEmptyCeiling stays 0 and is now COMPONENT-scoped. The file-level heuristic let any skeleton anywhere in a file vouch for every <Empty> in it; an <Empty> must now be reachable only after a loading guard in the same render function. The whole-file arm is kept and UNIONed with it, because component scoping alone would weaken the mirror case (component A reads the loading signal, component B renders the Empty). The count is renders, not files.
